description: This file defines the class DatabaseUserPermissionEvaluator, which contains methods for evaluating database permissions and schema modifications, primarily for testing database capabilities within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DatabaseUserPermissionEvaluator
classes.description: This class provides methods to evaluate create, read, update, delete, alter, and foreign key permissions on the database, as well as perform schema modifications, primarily for testing database capabilities and permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the class with a Doctrine DBAL Connection object.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the Doctrine DBAL Connection object.

methods.name: getSchemaHelper
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns a SchemaHelper instance for schema operations.

methods.name: evalCreatePermission
methods.description: Creates a temporary table with various column types and constraints to test create permissions.

methods.name: evalCrudPermission
methods.description: Performs insert, select, update, delete, and complex query operations to evaluate CRUD permissions.

methods.name: evalAlterPermission
methods.description: Performs alter operations: add, change, rename, and delete columns to evaluate schema modification permissions.

methods.name: evalForeignKeyPermission
methods.description: Creates foreign key constraints, inserts related data, and performs join queries to evaluate foreign key constraints and related permissions.

methods.name: evalDropPermission
methods.description: Drops the temporary tables and foreign key constraints to evaluate drop permissions.

methods.name: evalPrivilegeDatabaseUserPermission
methods.description: Runs a sequence of schema modifications and cleanup operations, testing various permissions associated with database users.
